04a943bca82a24db.description: The Procurement Cost Control Specialist manages procurement cost control and supplier payment activities within the Procurement & Cost Control Unit. The role monitors procurement spend against approved budgets, validates supplier invoices, and ensures supplier payments are processed accurately and on time in line with contractual terms, the delegation of authority, and company policies, while providing cost and savings reporting that supports sound financial control. Key Responsibilities: Supplier Invoice Validation & Payment Processing Procurement Cost Monitoring & Budget Control Supplier Reconciliation & Cost Optimization Reporting, Compliance & Audit Support Minimum 2–4 years of experience in procurement cost control, accounts payable, procurement finance, or a related field. Good understanding of the procure-to-pay (P2P) cycle, budget monitoring, cost analysis, and supplier account reconciliation. Working knowledge of basic accounting principles, KSA VAT regulations, and ZATCA e-invoicing requirements. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and the ability to meet payment deadlines.

04b02bf9687512d0.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن حاجتها لطبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية المفصلة من المريض وذويه، ودراسة الحالة المرضية بشكل شامل. إجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن موضوع التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المتبعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها بشكل منظم ودقيق. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. شهادة الاختصاص في المجال الطبي ذي الصلة. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة بدوام كامل في صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان بمدينة الخبر، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية وداعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

0490f5d137d341a2.description: About the Role Astek is seeking a Digital Product & Portfolio Manager to lead the business-side coordination of a portfolio of digital products, platforms, and capabilities for one of our clients. This part-time role is based in Makkah, with operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The successful candidate will translate customer and business needs into clear product roadmaps, prioritized initiatives, and delivery-ready requirements. Role Context and Collaboration This is a hands-on position that requires close collaboration with various teams, including business, technology, architecture, UX/CX, data, cybersecurity, and external partners. The manager will be responsible for maintaining an integrated roadmap across digital products, customer journeys, platforms, and strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives. Key Responsibilities Maintain an integrated roadmap across digital products, customer journeys, platforms, and strategic initiatives. Assess and prioritize opportunities based on business value, customer impact, readiness, risk, dependencies, and strategic alignment. Lead discovery and define customer problems, use cases, capabilities, requirements, and success measures. Coordinate connected capabilities across eCommerce, CRM, customer engagement, Voice of Customer, analytics, AI, automation, and partner platforms. Manage product backlogs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release scope. Coordinate business-side delivery from design and build through testing, launch, stabilization, and ongoing optimization. Work with Architecture and Engineering to assess solution options, including build, buy, reuse, and hybrid approaches. Monitor adoption, conversion, customer experience, and operational performance; recommend improvements. Support portfolio governance, executive reporting, business cases, investment analysis, and vendor coordination. Coordinate UAT, operational readiness, launch requirements, and inputs from cybersecurity, privacy, legal, accessibility, and quality teams. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in digital product and portfolio management. Work Type and Location This is a part-time position. The role is based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering operations in both Jeddah and Makkah.

04d1b542b5eb0b57.description: The Facility Management Services role focuses on ensuring the effective operation and maintenance of building systems, infrastructure, utilities, and associated facilities while maintaining compliance with contractual requirements, health and safety standards, and operational procedures. The position supports preventive and corrective maintenance, technical inspections, contractor performance monitoring, asset management, and service quality assurance to ensure facilities remain safe, reliable, efficient, and fit for purpose. . Facilities Operations & Management Coordinate day-to-day facilities management activities across the Workers Villages. Ensure services are delivered in accordance with contractual requirements, KPIs, SLAs, and operational procedures. Conduct routine site inspections to verify facility conditions, service quality, and compliance. Coordinate with operations teams and service providers to resolve technical and operational issues. Identify service gaps and recommend improvements to enhance operational efficiency. 2. Hard Services & Maintenance Monitor maintenance activities covering mechanical, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, civil, building fabric, ELV, and fire protection systems. Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance programs. Monitor maintenance work orders and ensure timely resolution of faults and service requests. Review technical reports, inspection findings, and root cause analyses. Identify recurring equipment failures and recommend corrective and preventive measures. Ensure critical assets are maintained in accordance with manufacturer recommendations and applicable standards. 3. Soft Services Coordination Monitor the delivery of cleaning, landscaping, irrigation, pest control, waste management, and other environmental services. Conduct service quality inspections and verify compliance with agreed scopes of work. Coordinate with service providers to address deficiencies and close out inspection findings. Recommend service improvements to maintain hygiene, cleanliness, and resident satisfaction. 4. Utilities & Infrastructure Management Monitor the operation and maintenance of potable water, sewage treatment, irrigation, electrical distribution, water storage, pumping stations, and associated utility systems. Review utility consumption and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce wastage. Coordinate investigation and resolution of utility failures and service interruptions. Monitor the condition and performance of utility infrastructure. Ensure utility-related activities comply with operational and environmental requirements. 5. Health, Safety & Fire Life Safety Ensure facilities management activities comply with applicable HSE requirements and fire and life safety standards. Participate in site safety inspections, risk assessments, and compliance audits. Monitor the implementation of Permit to Work (PTW) procedures where applicable. Identify hazards, unsafe practices, and non-conformances, and coordinate corrective actions. Support emergency preparedness and ensure reported safety issues are addressed promptly. 6. Contractor & Vendor Management Coordinate and monitor contractors, subcontractors, and specialist service providers. Review maintenance schedules, method statements, risk assessments, and work permits as required. Monitor contractor performance against contractual requirements and agreed KPIs. Inspect completed works and verify compliance with technical specifications and quality standards. Maintain records of contractor performance, deficiencies, and corrective actions. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. 7–10 years of relevant experience in facilities management and maintenance operations. Experience in contractor management, maintenance planning, and building systems. Strong technical, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

04e9359da20e04d1.description: About the Role Elsewedy Electric Power Systems Projects is seeking a Project Store Administration Senior Specialist to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is central to ensuring the efficient and compliant management of project materials, from receipt and inspection to storage and issuance. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage all aspects of material handling within project operations. This includes overseeing receipt, inspection, storage, issuance, and disposal processes to maintain accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency. The specialist will be responsible for upholding stock record integrity, optimizing storage systems, and adhering to safety standards, all while ensuring continuous material availability for project needs. Key Responsibilities Oversee the unloading, inspection, and systematic storage of materials in designated locations. Verify material quantities and specifications against relevant purchasing documents to ensure accuracy. Organize and maintain storage areas in accordance with manufacturer’s guidelines and established company safety procedures. Monitor and replenish material levels proactively to prevent shortages and ensure uninterrupted project operations. Maintain precise stock records and a comprehensive filing system, adhering strictly to company procedures. Issue and distribute materials to labor, subcontractors, and clients as per company protocols. Recommend and coordinate the disposal of excess, defective, or expired materials in compliance with company guidelines. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in project store administration or a similar field. Demonstrated ability to manage material receipt, storage, and issuance processes effectively. Proficiency in maintaining accurate stock records and inventory systems. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, with project activities extending to Jeddah. The role is full-time, supporting critical project operations within the region.

044e54fa714862f3.description: About Saipem Saipem is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. With 30,000 employees from over 130 nationalities across more than 50 countries, Saipem is driven by technological innovation to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. The company focuses on environmental sustainability and operates with a culture built on mutual respect, collaboration, and inclusion. The Role of Talent Acquisition Lead Saipem is seeking a Talent Acquisition Lead to join the Human Resources department in Dhahran, Eastern Province, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position reporting to the HR Manager within the Energy Carries division. The role involves leading talent acquisition efforts, with opportunities for international travel based on project requirements within KSA and abroad. Key Responsibilities Forecast hiring needs, design long-term talent acquisition roadmaps, and align recruitment budgets with business objectives. Manage, mentor, and evaluate internal recruitment and sourcing teams. Partner with project management, department heads, and regional leaders to understand workforce requirements. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and retention, ensuring compliance with local labor and employment laws. Design and implement local talent strategies to meet strict regional compliance goals, including Saudization and In-Country Value programs. Track competitor projects and regional salary shifts to dynamically adjust hiring strategies and compensation benchmarks. Elevate company positioning in the job market through recruitment marketing, events, and candidate experience initiatives. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition. Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor recruitment teams. Strong understanding of local labor and employment laws, particularly in the context of regional compliance mandates. Experience in strategic planning for talent acquisition and budget alignment. Proficiency in tracking recruitment KPIs and utilizing market intelligence for strategic adjustments. Benefits and Professional Development Saipem offers a comprehensive benefits package, which includes a permanent contract. The company supports employee development through its "One Saipem Way" soft skills model, which focuses on skills development, career growth, and opportunities to innovate through complex challenges by promoting communication and collaboration. Saipem is committed to the health and safety of its people and the preservation of the natural ecosystem, operating with a strong focus on safety and sustainability. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply. Saipem embraces diversity and encourages applications from individuals who believe they can contribute to the company's business development. All applicants should consult the privacy policy in accordance with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and Royal Decree No. M/148 dated 05/09/1444H (27 March 2023), as well as GDPR regulations.

0419f8c700ab508e.description: About The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, *** The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, *** operates over 100 award-winning properties globally, known for creating exceptional guest experiences. The company focuses on attracting top hospitality professionals and fostering a culture where creativity, thoughtfulness, and compassion are valued. The Ritz-Carlton is committed to delivering excellence in luxury service, guided by its "Gold Standards," which include the Employee Promise, Credo, and Service Values. Joining The Ritz-Carlton means becoming part of the Marriott International portfolio of brands. Role Summary The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for responding to and resolving guest repair requests, performing preventative maintenance, and ensuring the operational integrity of tools and equipment. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves maintaining inventory, adhering to safety protocols, and upholding the service standards of The Ritz-Carlton. Key Responsibilities Respond to and address guest repair requests promptly. Communicate with guests to resolve maintenance issues effectively. Perform preventative maintenance on tools and equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines for proper function. Transport equipment such as tools and radios as required. Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment. Manage maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Record information for unfinished calls before shift changes. Adhere to all company, safety, and security policies and procedures. Report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Properly store flammable materials according to safety guidelines. Ensure a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, anticipate service needs, and assist individuals with disabilities. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships, support team goals, and respond to employee concerns. Communicate using clear and professional language. Perform physical tasks including moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Navigate stairs, service ramps, and ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Execute other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Demonstrated ability to perform maintenance tasks and troubleshoot issues. Proficiency in maintaining safety and security protocols. Ability to communicate effectively with guests and team members. Physical capability to perform job duties, including lifting and movement as described. Company Culture and Standards As an Engineering Supervisor at The Ritz-Carlton, you will be integral to upholding the company's "Gold Standards," which guide daily operations and service delivery. These standards are foundational to the brand's reputation as a global leader in luxury hospitality. The role involves embodying the Employee Promise, Credo, and Service Values, contributing to a culture that drives success through empowerment and compassion.

0443cfc72e4eec0e.description: نبذة عن الدور يقدم مصرف الراجحي فرصة وظيفية لاستشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. يشمل هذا الدور، الذي يتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، العمل بدوام كامل في مدن مثل الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، بقيق، راس تنورة، صفوى، الجش، عنك، دارين، العمران، المبرز، والجفر. يركز الدور على تقديم المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى استشاري المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات المصرفية بسلاسة وفعالية، مع التركيز على خدمة العملاء وتلبية احتياجاتهم. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها على الأنظمة المخصصة. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، إدخال البيانات والتوقيعات في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). استقبال العملاء في الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة، مع توجيههم لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة وتوجيههم لاستخدام أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات، قفل الحسابات، وتعديل بيانات الحسابات وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نماذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيعات، وإدخالها في النظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال التنفيذ. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. تحويل مشاكل العملاء إلى مدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة في الفرع وتوجيه العملاء لاستلامها. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن أي حالات مخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحين يمتلكون المهارات الأساسية لخدمة العملاء والتعامل مع العمليات المصرفية. يجب أن تتوافر في المتقدمين المؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة إدخال البيانات المصرفية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم خدمة عملاء احترافية. الالتزام بالدقة والاحترافية في إنجاز المهام. بيئة العمل يُعد هذا الدور وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في المنطقة الشرقية، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ومحفزة لتطوير المهارات المصرفية وخدمة العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في مصرف الراجحي.

04649c75345a210a.description: About Future Connect Future Connect is seeking a Field Sales Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Our client, a growing company specializing in integrated home services, provides solutions such as residential cleaning, pest control, furniture moving, and home maintenance. The company focuses on delivering reliable customer experiences, expanding its market presence, and building long-term customer relationships through recurring services and subscriptions. The Role The Field Sales Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing field sales strategies to achieve sales targets and drive revenue growth. This full-time role involves leading and motivating a team of field sales representatives, identifying new business opportunities, and expanding the customer base within residential communities and targeted areas. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement field sales strategies to achieve sales targets and drive revenue growth. Lead, manage, and motivate field sales representatives to achieve individual and team objectives. Identify new business opportunities and expand the customer base across residential communities and targeted areas. Drive sales of home services and increase recurring subscriptions, renewals, and cross-selling opportunities. Build and maintain relationships with residential compounds, property management companies, and real estate developers. Plan and monitor daily field visits, sales activities, and team performance. Analyze sales results, customer acquisition, retention, and collection performance. Maintain accurate customer records and sales pipelines through CRM systems. Coordinate with operations and marketing teams to ensure service availability and customer satisfaction. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. At least 6–7 years of sales experience, including a minimum of 2 years in a sales management or team leadership role. Proven experience in B2C field sales and managing sales teams. Experience in home services, residential cleaning, pest control, home maintenance, or facilities services is highly preferred. Skills and Attributes Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills. Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage team performance. Good knowledge of CRM systems and sales performance reporting. Valid Saudi driving license and willingness to work in the field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring regular field work and team management. The role involves working within a dynamic environment focused on expanding market presence and building customer relationships in the home services sector.

047d1abf631a7acd.description: About the Role Norconsult Telematics is seeking a PowerPoint Storyteller to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for supporting the delivery team by creating professional and visually engaging corporate slide packs. The ideal candidate will be a graphic storyteller capable of transforming complex information into clear, concise, and well-organized presentations. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with senior management to convert written content into compelling visual presentations, simplifying complex information. Conduct interviews with users, understand business requirements, review existing data, gather additional information, and build a library of resources and suggested templates. Interpret complex concepts and translate them into easy-to-understand graphs, charts, and visual graphics for critical presentations and internal use. Distil clear messaging and integrate smart visual solutions that enhance major business decisions during high-stakes meetings. Develop innovative approaches to presentation design and delivery. Create original graphic content for slides tailored to diverse audiences, with experience in financial services and business consulting being an advantage. Attend meetings with stakeholders to identify and implement graphic solutions for complex problems. Contribute to the innovative development of a dynamic business consulting practice. Ensure quality assurance for all deliverables. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor of Engineering degree. 5-10 years of relevant experience. Required Skills Proficiency in graphic design and visual storytelling. Ability to simplify complex information into clear visual formats. Strong collaboration and communication skills. Attention to detail and commitment to quality. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time basis within a collaborative delivery team environment. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

049ae4fe8f4eb1db.description: About the Role Afaq - Warehouse Branch is seeking an Inbound Placement Program Manager, AMET - Supply Chain to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is critical for ensuring end-to-end launch readiness across all Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and Stores within the Core, Rush, and Now networks. The manager will lead configuration design, planning, and execution readiness for new nodes, ensuring operational scalability and compliance with Amazon standards. Role Context and Impact This position involves close collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain, Tech, and Business teams to define launch scope and validate configuration inputs, including inbound, outbound, and storage topology. The incumbent will manage readiness checkpoints from the planning phase through Go-Live, standardizing launch mechanisms and ensuring alignment with S&OP, topology, and capacity plans. The role acts as the single-threaded owner for configuration health across multiple speed networks, requiring a deep understanding of fulfillment network design, operational processes, and cross-functional project management. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end configuration readiness for all new FCs, SDCs, IXDs, and stores across Core, Rush, and Now networks. Define and track readiness milestones, covering inbound, storage, outbound, systems, and capacity, from planning through Go-Live. Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, and Business teams to validate launch inputs, volume ramp plans, and operational dependencies. Translate planning inputs into executable operational readiness milestones. Standardize launch mechanisms and ensure alignment with S&OP, topology, and capacity plans. Required Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated understanding of fulfillment network design and operational processes. Proven experience in cross-functional project management. Skills and Attributes Ability to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders. Strong analytical skills to validate configuration inputs and volume ramp plans. Excellent communication and collaboration skills for partnering with various teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring a proactive approach to managing launch readiness across a dynamic network of fulfillment centers and stores.

0466c461a5e1c2c0.description: Job Title: Technical Engineering Manager Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Department: Engineering Reporting to: Chief Operations Officer Employment Type: Full-time About the Role UNIMAC is seeking an experienced and strategic Head of Technical Services to lead and oversee its Technical Services function across a diverse portfolio of construction projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and implementing company-wide technical standards, strengthening engineering coordination, leading Building Information Modeling (BIM) and digital delivery strategies, and ensuring consistent technical performance across all projects. This is a senior leadership role requiring extensive experience in engineering management, multidisciplinary coordination, BIM implementation, and technical governance within the construction sector, preferably in Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Governance: Establish, implement, and maintain company-wide technical standards, engineering procedures, BIM execution requirements, shop drawing workflows, RFI management protocols, and survey and as-built documentation standards. Engineering Coordination: Provide functional leadership and technical guidance to Engineering Managers across projects, ensuring effective multidisciplinary coordination and compliance with approved procedures. Portfolio Oversight: Monitor technical delivery performance across active projects, conduct technical reviews and BIM audits, and proactively address engineering coordination issues that may affect project quality, cost, or schedule. BIM & Digital Delivery: Develop and implement the company's BIM strategy, digital delivery standards, model management procedures, BIM execution plans, and reusable templates to improve consistency and efficiency. Technical Problem-Solving: Act as the senior escalation point for complex design conflicts, coordination challenges, BIM compliance issues, and RFI backlogs. Tendering & Preconstruction Support: Provide technical input during tendering, review BIM and engineering requirements, and contribute to technical methodologies and delivery strategies for prospective projects. Performance Management: Establish appropriate technical performance indicators and provide regular reports to the Chief Operations Officer on portfolio performance, risks, compliance, and improvement initiatives. Resource & Capability Development: Optimize the deployment of engineering and BIM resources across projects and strengthen organizational technical capabilities through continuous improvement and knowledge sharing. Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with project teams, clients, consultants, and other stakeholders to promote effective technical coordination and ensure alignment with contractual and regulatory requirements. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum of 15 years of relevant professional experience , including at least 5 years in senior engineering management, technical leadership, or BIM and digital delivery management. Demonstrated experience managing engineering and technical services across multiple construction projects. Strong background in heavy civil infrastructure and building construction, with extensive multidisciplinary design coordination experience. Minimum of 8 years of experience in Saudi Arabia , with sound knowledge of the Saudi Building Code, local regulatory requirements, and authority approval processes. Active registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers, as applicable to the candidate's engineering discipline and professional status. Experience implementing BIM standards, preferably aligned with ISO 19650, and developing BIM Execution Plans (BEPs). Strong knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, Common Data Environments (CDEs), shop drawing production, RFI management, surveying, and as-built documentation. Proven ability to establish technical standards, manage complex engineering interfaces, and lead teams across multiple projects. Key Competencies Strategic leadership and technical governance Multidisciplinary engineering coordination BIM strategy and digital construction delivery Technical risk management and problem-solving Stakeholder engagement and communication Resource planning and performance management Process improvement and organizational capability development Language Requirements Fluent English is required. Arabic language proficiency is an advantage.

If you require assistance or an accommodation to complete your application, please contact us at [Click to show email] Notice: Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal Notice: Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination (English) Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Airbus Americas, Inc is looking for a A320 Customer Line Quality Inspector Mechanic (Rotating Shifts) to join our team based in Mobile, AL . The A320 Customer Line Quality Inspector Mechanic (Rotating Shifts) is responsible for the planning, execution and verification of the A320 Quality activities in the Flightline and Delivery phases, starting from the milestone FOT in the FAL to the final delivery to the customer. This includes the demonstration of aircraft system integrity and conformity in accordance to the design specification by the verification of ground test instruction (GTI). KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: To inspect, test, attest & conduct corrective action management, Prevent & promote FOD eradication, Manage Non conformities as appropriate, Be the go-to person on the shop floor for Quality issues, Carry out Improvement and Coaching as appropriate. Meet the Team: Our Engineers at the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing facility take our aircraft from concept to customer delivery – working with production teams on every aspect of assembly from managing technical information, quality control, maintenance tasks and health & safety – along flowlines and flightlines. Join our team and watch our aircraft come to life. Your Working Environment: On ‘Airbus Way’ you will find the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing Facility for commercial aircraft. Opened at the Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley in 2015, the facility produces A320 Family aircraft and added a second product line for the A220 in 2019. The facility, which strengthens the U.S. aerospace industry, is part of Airbus’ strategy to enhance its global competitiveness by meeting the growing needs of its customers in the United States and beyond. How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility. Your Challenges: 1. L3 Flightline Quality Inspector 60 % Take accountability for the whole aircraft integrity during the Customer Line phase. Authorize and release aircraft for all ground and flight operations (including Engine Run-up Inspections, Pre- and Post-flight checks under EASA Part 21G, and post-transfer of title under FAA 14 CFR Part 145). Perform and advise Quality Inspections as per defined standards, Final Checks and Attestation, Stop Points, Out of sequence work, including critical activities. Conduct comprehensive aircraft system testing, evaluating and formally documenting test results and discrepancies in the Airbus Log Book (ALB). Perform and attest aircraft operational and functional tests following test instructions (GTI, RTI, AMM, etc.). Take responsibility for the safety of the people, and the Aircraft during operational and functional tests. Ensure and guarantee the traceability of completed maintenance tasks as well as the aircraft conformity. Lead and support complex troubleshooting (T/S) on integrated aircraft systems, taking accountability for troubleshooting during ground tests. Use problem-solving methods and tools for solving repetitive issues and participate in the continuous improvement of test procedures. Drive continuous quality improvement initiatives and resolve technical issues collaboratively with engineering teams, customers, and suppliers. Contribute to the aircraft technical status meeting during industrial milestones. Embody a “Customer Focus” oriented mindset, taking into account the feedback/experience of the Delivery Center to improve the customer satisfaction. Provide feedback and support to Operations & Support Functions on Quality issues and observations from Operational Surveillance. Contribute to deploy and support Airbus Operating System methodology- Quality Performance System (QPS) bricks : Practical Problem Solving (PPS) , Customer Protection Board (CPB) , Non Quality Management (NQM). Verify and certify aircraft conformity as a Quality Inspector holding final signature authorization. Depending on operational proficiency: Become the aircraft technical and quality focal point; manage activities & release aircraft for maintenance activities; release A/C to enter into service post maintenance activities. 2. : FAL-GTE (Final Assembly Line - Ground Test Engineer) 35 % Operate the aircraft in delegation of the flight test department, representing them by executing post-FOT aircraft ground checks, preparing testing environments, logging nonconformities in the ALB, and issuing Repeat Test Instructions (RTI) following rework completion. Perform the Airbus Log Book (ALB) opening and transfer all items affecting aircraft configuration, operation, test, airworthiness or flight safety into the ALB after the FAL Operational Test (FOT) acceptance. Execute static system tests, APU/Engine Destorage, low/high-power engine run testing, low-speed taxiing, and compass swings in strict compliance with the Production Aircraft Test Manual (PATM) and Ground Test Instructions (GTIs). 3. FAA Part 145 Repair Station Inspector 5 % Perform aircraft testing, evaluate technical outcomes, and document findings and discrepancies within the Part 145 Work Package. Execute advanced troubleshooting and system diagnostics across complex aircraft systems. Maintain regulatory compliance of the Part 145 Work Package and execute official Release to Service authorizations. Additional Responsibilities: Perform additional operational duties and special projects as assigned Your Boarding Pass: High School Graduate or equivalent Airbus A320 T1 & T2 training preferred 3 years of Quality Inspection experience preferably on A320 Family aircraft in an aviation company FAA issued A & P license or EASA Part 66 license (for FAA 14 CFR Part 145 activities after Transfer of Title) Experience in troubleshooting Airframe/Powerplant Systems Flightline experience preferred Leadership experience Knowledge of drawing systems, inspection plans and inspection processes Knowledge of inspection principles, practices, methods and tools used on the production line Knowledge of rules for aircraft design and manufacturing Extensive knowledge on A320 Family Systems Clear and precise English communication skills, able to give direction Proven experience in the performance of GTI’s (Ground Test Instruction) Airframe/Powerplant System Licensure/Certifications: FAA issued A & P license or EASA Part 66 license (for FAA 14 CFR Part 145 activities after Transfer of Title) Travel Required: 10 % Domestic and International Eligibility: Eligible for employment in the US without sponsorship. Physical Requirements: Vision : adequate to read material (electronic or paper), aircraft gauges, airport signage, safety labels and signage. 045dd1e2d1667e5b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اثمار التشييد والبناء للمقاولات عن فني طرق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم مشاريع إنشاء الطرق من خلال أداء الواجبات الفنية الأساسية، بما في ذلك جمع العينات ومطابقة المواصفات وتقدير الكميات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة مهندس الطرق في إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالمعاينة ومتابعة التنفيذ وضبط الجودة. أخذ عينات من تربة مسار الطريق ومواد إنشاء الطريق والخلطات الإسفلتية، وإرسالها للمختبر، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. تفقد الأعمال في إنشاء الطريق أثناء التنفيذ وبعد الانتهاء للتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير المطلوبة. المشاركة في قياس العمل المنجز بالتنسيق المباشر مع المهندس المشرف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بإنشاء الطرق أو الأعمال الفنية المماثلة. القدرة على أداء الواجبات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الطرق. القدرة على جمع العينات من تربة المسار والمواد الإنشائية. فهم جيد لمتطلبات مطابقة المواصفات الفنية. القدرة على تقدير كميات المواد والعمالة اللازمة للمشاريع. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل ضمن مشاريع الشركة في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم عمليات إنشاء الطرق. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

04765c5ed0ef46d3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مساجد طيبة عن مصمم جرافيك للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير الأفكار والمفاهيم الإبداعية لتوصيل الرسائل المطلوبة بصريًا، مع وضع المخططات العامة وتصميم الإنتاج لمختلف الوسائط المنشورة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التنسيق مع أصحاب التصميم (العملاء الداخليين أو الخارجيين) لفهم الرسالة المراد نقلها، وتحديد المتطلبات، والاتفاق على المنتج النهائي. تطوير مفاهيم التصميم العامة التي تلبي احتياجات العميل، وصياغة أسلوب يتناسب مع الصورة والوضع المطلوبين. تقديم المشورة الفنية المتعلقة بمفاهيم التصميم العامة، وتقديم التوجيه بشأن المتطلبات الأسلوبية مثل الألوان، الصور، نمط النص، والمخطط العام لتوصيل الرسالة بفعالية. تسليم المنتج النهائي للعميل، وجمع الملاحظات، وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير، وعرضها، وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تصميم الجرافيك. القدرة على تطوير الأفكار الإبداعية والمفاهيم البصرية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنسيق مع الأطراف المعنية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.
